allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Restructuring the utilisation of proceeds from the Preferential Issue of Equity Shares '.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has executed and registered the lease agreement on dated 13th June 2025 for industrial land measuring 178,200 Sq. Mt. at Banda, Sagar, Madhya Pradesh, allotted by the Madhya Pradesh Industrial Development Corporation Ltd (MPIDC).The total land of Madhya Bharat Agro Products Ltd at Banda, Sagar now stands at 641,656 Sq. Mt. The land is intended for future expansion and industrial development projects of the company.'.
